title: A checkpoint metrics error aborts the entire problem report
reasoning: create_problem_reports promises reports plus checkpoint-specific errors and continues past missing directories, but calls get_checkpoint_metrics without handling MetricsError. The sibling single-checkpoint function explicitly recognizes that exception. One existing checkpoint with invalid or incomplete metrics therefore prevents returning reports already collected and prevents processing later checkpoints.
reproduction: Provide multiple checkpoint directories and make get_checkpoint_metrics raise MetricsError for an intermediate checkpoint. create_problem_reports raises instead of returning successful reports and an error tuple.
recommendation: Catch MetricsError per checkpoint, append the checkpoint-specific error, and continue collecting reports. Explicitly preserve the intended prior-checkpoint comparison semantics across failures.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied metrics tests exercise source measurement and batching, not entrypoint report collection or its partial-failure contract.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise a sequence containing successful, missing, and metrics-failing checkpoints; verify all usable reports and checkpoint-specific errors are returned and comparison inputs remain correct.
